messages:
Evelyn Hart: HelioHealth wants EU-only residency. Procurement also asked if APAC support can ever access their tenant during escalations. They will allow it if audited + time-limited.
Aisha Rahman: We can document as a residency exception: out-of-region *personnel access* to audit logs/metadata only. No payload logs. Time-bound it and point to break-glass.
Jonas Weber: Confirmed break-glass is RBAC role + TTL. Access is logged. We should be explicit: audit logs stored in EU, but person location could be APAC.
Evelyn Hart: Works. Ill send customer confirmation + open SUP ticket.
Aisha Rahman: Please link exception record and specify monthly access report available on request.
